description: This file implements the GrainStorageSerializer class, which manages serialization and deserialization of grain state data by delegating to a primary and fallback serializer as per the Orleans.Storage namespace.

classes.name: GrainStorageSerializer
classes.description: A serializer that uses a primary and fallback serializer to handle serialize and deserialize operations for grain state data.

methods.name: GrainStorageSerializer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the serializer with a primary and fallback serializer.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes input data using the primary serializer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes input data using the primary serializer, and falls back to the fallback serializer if the primary fails.

calls: throw new AggregateException("Failed to deserialize input", ex1, ex2)
